query:
SELECT
            m.id,

            COALESCE(
                m.value_float,
                m.value_integer::float8,
                CASE WHEN m.value_bool THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
            )::float8 AS "value!",

            m.date::text AS "date!",
            c.name AS "chain!",
            c.id AS "chain_id!"

        FROM metrics m
        JOIN chains c ON c.id = m.chain_id
        WHERE c.user_id = $1
          AND c.active = true
          AND m.date >= $2
        ORDER BY m.date ASC, c.id ASC
